svg.aria-label: agoranomos pipeline: demo data, dlt, the PostgreSQL warehouse with the layers raw, staging, core and marts, Metabase and the MCP servers run today, with Airflow running the load and the dbt build. dbt builds staging from raw and writes the permanent core, and the marts are views over the core. The connectors of Google Ads and Meta are in place, with no load on a real account yet. The Claude apps and Claude Code reach the data through the MCP servers: the one built into Metabase and, in local mode, the read-only servers of the warehouse and of Airflow. The Metabase refresh, the connectors of more ad platforms and of GA4, CRM and files, the MCP server of dbt and the AI clients ChatGPT, Gemini and Kimi are planned. Metabase and the AI clients, which people work with, are framed in blue
